# the RNG from 2363). Frozen 14z-184 with FREEZE=1, its rule-checker run named in the commit. RE-FROZEN 14z-185 on
# merged-m21 (build/m3b_merged29, the M21 freeze; rule-checker run 2026-09-28-391 OK): #182's fix (Design A) turns the

# ours changing — read the diff as that.
